name: com.audioparcel/audioparcel
title: AudioParcel – Audio Trim & Export Guide
description: Plan audio trims, choose an export format, and open AudioParcel's browser editor or playable demo.

tools.name: get_audio_trimmer_info
tools.description: Return supported input types, output formats, and limits for one audio recording.

tools.name: plan_audio_trim
tools.description: Check a start and end time and return the settings for trimming one continuous clip in the browser editor.

startSeconds.description: Start of the clip in seconds.

endSeconds.description: End of the clip in seconds.

sourceDurationSeconds.description: Full length of the source, if known.

exportFormat.description: Output format. Defaults to MP3 for sharing.

tools.name: open_audio_trim_example
tools.description: Get a browser link that opens the built-in CC0 voice sample with its cut points selected.
